items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal Interview, 1962-05-24
items.q: You wouldn't tell me, because we should have sent him a floor. He played in the, uh, Creole Fiestas, um, concert.

ctx.x: Well, he played the, you played the, didn't he ramble, yeah. Uh-huh.

You wouldn't tell me, because we should have sent him a floor. He played in the, uh, Creole Fiestas, um, concert. And there goes swag. He played that, uh, uh, Piccolo, Piccolo, Piccolo, huh? Well, he was the one, don't you remember? He played Piccolo, that, um, High Society? Oh, he, no one would play High Society like him. Oh, he played it that night like nobody did. And so, um, nobody told me about him. So, a nurse sneaked up in there and she said, Miss Senegal, did you know, um, Piccolo? I said, what Piccolo?…
